newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to pay many untaxed OFZ bonds voluntarily.
newsitem.headline: Russia to pay many untaxed OFZ bonds voluntarily.

text.p: Russia will voluntarily redeem many untaxed OFZ bonds at nominal value before maturity from June 18 on the date of each issue's subsequent coupon payment, the central bank said on Wednesday.
The order applies to bonds issued before January 21, 1997, it said in a statement. It thus does not apply to the fifth series of OFZs which matures after June 18 but has no further coupon payments.

The Central Bank said the redemption was voluntary and bondholders could use the funds they received to buy new taxed issues which would be offered at auctions or additional trading sessions on the day of redemption.
Coupons on unredeemed bonds would be calculated according to rules for tax-liable bonds, but coupon income would not be tax liable, it said.

Russia began issuing taxable Treasury bills and bonds this year but calculations of yields on unmatured OFZ bonds will become difficult as untaxed T-bills, upon which coupon yields are based, mature and leave the market.
The order applies to OFZs in the sixth through tenth series with original issues between February 7, 1996 and December 18, 1996.
